column1: # Package-manager tools this repo installs, by system type. Read by bin/dotfiles-deps
# (the installer feeds rows to ensure_tool; the Makefile preflight checks them).
# Tab-separated. probe = space-separated alternatives (satisfied if ANY is on PATH).
# linux-pkg "-" = not offered on Linux. group joins to the installer's DO_* toggles
# (core is always installed). required = hard-fail in preflight / warned in installer.
